name: Soda
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was used by the game helpers along with the Cake and BBQ paints, on special accounts during {GAME_NAME}'s birthday event in June 2020.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
Operators of tanks wearing this paint have needed a lot of dental work in the past. Make sure to drink some water to wash it down!
